name: Exhausting Rage
body:
Your rage is so powerful that you become exhausted once you calm down.

Prerequisite: Rage Ability

Effect: At the end of your rage you become exhausted(instead of fatigued) for the duration of the encounter. Once you gain the rage tirelessly ability, you instead become fatigued after a rage.
